style.description: The file extension or preprocessor to use for style files.

skipTests.description: When true, does not create "spec.ts" test files for the app.

fileNameStyleGuide.description: The file naming convention to use for generated files. `2016` uses classic suffixes such as `.component.ts`. `2025` omits type suffixes. When omitted, the convention already used by the project is auto-detected.
